not: Not a copy of any channel, character, set, title, or script. A camera grammar for original 9:16 diorama explainers: a flat illustrated character standing in a lit 3D room.

format.unit: meters in a full-size room. If the set is a miniature, multiply every distance by the same scale. Never mix scales.

why_these_numbers: A flat character card breaks past about 25 degrees of orbit: the ellipse of the head and the contact shadow give it away. Arcs stop at 22 degrees.
A phone cut during acceleration reads as a glitch. Every move arrives, then holds 8 frames.
Lens zoom flattens the room, so the small prop never feels like it is inside a big consequence. Dolly unless a preset says otherwise.
Shake, 360 spins, and constant bouncing hide the prop. Violence is a camera that STOPS, not a camera that shakes.
hard_rules: One primary preset per shot. A second behavior only if it is listed in that preset's compounds.
If no preset fits, use quiet-push. Do not invent a move, an orbit, a zoom, or a shake.
No animated roll. Dutch is not in this pack.
No fade-in as a shot. Picture is already framed. A 4-frame dip from black is allowed only on shot 1.
Captions never cover the prop the sentence is about.
The 2D character is unshaded. Do not relight the card to sell the camera move. Light the room.
Contact shadow stays under the feet for the whole move.
Screen direction stays the same until a character actually turns around.
New information earns a new shot. A new shot does not earn a new set.
Land the camera 8 frames before the cut.

lenses.use: A face or a pair of hands.
The prop is the sentence. Background compresses.

modifiers.behavior: On the contact frame, camera velocity reaches 0 in 2 frames and stays 0 through the cut hold. Do not add shake, flash, or roll.
modifiers.why: The hit reads because everything else stops.

presets.name: Prop macro
presets.job: Open on the object, or return to it when the mechanism is named.
presets.focus: prop surface, a real detail (edge, notch, stamp), not the center of a blur
presets.path: Slow dolly back 0.20m and rise 0.07m. No yaw. No roll. No lens zoom.
presets.parallax: The prop's near edge moves more than its far edge. If it scales like a sticker, you zoomed. Redo as a dolly.
do_not: Do not put a title card in front of this shot.
Do not orbit. At 85mm an arc turns into a smear.
Do not let the prop touch the caption band.
presets.video_model_line: 85mm macro of one small object on a table, camera dollies back 20 centimeters and rises slightly over 1.3 seconds, cubic ease-out, no zoom, no orbit, shallow focus on a real surface detail, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Quiet push
presets.job: Default listening shot while a fact is said. Use this when unsure.
presets.focus: character card eyes, or the prop if the line is about the prop
presets.path: Dolly in 0.35m on a straight line. Height locked. No pan.
presets.parallax: A foreground mug, post, or door edge must slide a little. If nothing nearer than the character exists, the push looks like a zoom. Add one foreground piece.
do_not: Do not push more than 0.35m. Bigger reads as comedy.
Do not add handheld noise.
Do not use this twice in a row with the same framing size. Change size or change preset.
presets.video_model_line: 35mm, eye height, slow straight dolly in of 35 centimeters over 2.2 seconds, cubic ease in and out, no pan, no zoom, no shake, a nearer object slides against the back wall, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Consequence pull
presets.job: Prove the small object sits inside a result big enough to matter.
presets.focus: start on the prop, widen so the room is readable by the end. Do not blur the prop away.
presets.path: Dolly back 1.7m and pedestal up 0.65m. Counter-tilt only enough to keep the prop planted on the lower third. Yaw 0. Roll 0. Lens stays 24mm.
presets.parallax: Floorboards and ceiling must both enter frame. That is the proof of height.
do_not: Do not lose the prop.
Do not zoom out.
Do not crane so high the character becomes a circle with no feet.
presets.video_model_line: 24mm camera dollies back 1.7 meters and rises 0.65 meters over 1.8 seconds, ease-out, no zoom, no yaw, the small prop stays on the lower third while the full room opens around it, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Parallax slider
presets.job: Cross a place while a sentence of context plays. The move is the geography.
presets.focus: the character or the work surface, not the passing foreground
presets.path: Truck 0.8m sideways. Counter-yaw about 10 degrees so the subject stays near the same screen position. One foreground shape (post, wheel, jar) crosses at least 30% of the frame width.
presets.easing: linear for the middle 70%, cubic ease both ends
presets.parallax: Three speeds: foreground fast, character medium, back wall slow. Two speeds means a missing layer.
do_not: Do not truck far enough to see the edge of the character card. 0.8m at 2.2m subject distance stays card-safe.
Do not pan instead of truck. A pan has no parallax.
presets.video_model_line: 35mm lateral truck of 0.8 meters over 2 seconds, slight counter-pan so the subject stays put, a foreground post crosses the frame, three distinct parallax speeds, no roll, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Boot crane
presets.job: Bring a person in from the ground they stand on. Use on an entrance or a status change.
presets.focus: feet at frame 0, eyes by the end

start.subject: boots and the floor contact shadow

end.subject: head and shoulders, feet may leave

presets.path: Pedestal up 1.1m while dollying out 0.3m so the head does not clip. Tilt follows. No yaw.
presets.parallax: The floor drops out of frame. The ceiling or the top of a door arrives.
do_not: Do not start above the knees. The shot is about contact with the ground.
Do not shoot so low the card's chin breaks into a crescent for the whole shot. Leave the low angle by frame 20.
presets.video_model_line: Camera starts at boot height looking slightly up, then rises to eye height over 1.6 seconds while easing back a little, tilt follows the body, no yaw, contact shadow visible at the start, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Arch pass
presets.job: Enter a room. The doorway, wheel, or window is a wipe made of scenery.
presets.focus: rack from the near frame (frame 0-10) to the subject (by frame 24)

end.subject: readable, not centered under a beam

presets.path: Dolly forward through the opening, about 1.1m of travel. A soft rack focus. No yaw beyond 5 degrees of correction.
presets.parallax: The arch leaves frame at the edges while the room inside grows. That edge-exit is the cut's motivation.
do_not: Do not fly through a solid wall.
Do not rack focus so late the subject is mush at the landing.
presets.video_model_line: 24mm camera moves forward through a doorway or wheel, the near frame slides off the edges, focus racks from that frame to the person inside, 1.7 seconds, no orbit, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Table arc 22
presets.job: Inspect an object with some ceremony. The only orbit in the pack, and it is small on purpose.
presets.focus: prop, held for the whole arc
presets.path: Orbit 22 degrees total around the prop at a fixed radius and height. Subject stays screen-center. Character cards in this shot must face within 15 degrees of the START camera, or be absent. A 22 degree arc will not show the card edge if they face the middle of the arc.
presets.parallax: The far side of the table and the near lip travel in opposite screen directions. If they travel together, the camera panned instead of orbiting.
do_not: Do not exceed 22 degrees.
Do not change radius. A spiral reads as dizziness on a phone.
Do not put a flat character on the far side of this arc.
presets.video_model_line: 50mm orbit of only 22 degrees around a tabletop object, radius and height locked, 2.4 seconds, ease in and out, object stays centered, no zoom, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Overhead settle
presets.job: A plan, track, or tabletop diagram becomes a place you could stand in.
presets.focus: deep. The diagram and the nearest person both readable at the end.
presets.path: Pitch opens from a steep top view toward a three-quarter view while the camera drops and eases back. Not a flat 2D zoom on a map.
presets.parallax: Parallel lines on the floor stop being parallel. That convergence is the whole point.
do_not: Do not go to a perfect 90 degree top-down and stay there. Phone viewers lose the room.
Do not include a flat character face in the steep first half. Show the set, the path, the prop. Faces return on the next shot.
presets.video_model_line: Start steeply above a floor plan or table, 24mm, then drop and tilt toward a three-quarter view over 1.8 seconds so parallel lines converge, deep focus, no zoom, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Hand track
presets.job: Show the cause being done. The hand is the verb.
presets.focus: the hand and the prop, together
presets.path: Truck or short dolly locked to the hand's path, never more than 0.45m. Camera leads the hand by about 4 frames, then stops when the hand stops. If you need the stop to feel like a hit, add impact-lock on the contact frame.
presets.easing: match the hand. Do not ease a motion the hand did not ease.
presets.parallax: The tabletop texture slides under the hand. The hand stays almost pinned on screen.
do_not: Do not orbit the hand.
Do not keep drifting after the hand has finished. The leftover drift looks like a mistake.
presets.video_model_line: 50mm camera tracks a hand placing or cutting a small object, hand stays near the same spot on screen, table slides under it, camera stops when the hand stops, shallow focus, no orbit, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Occluder clear
presets.job: Withhold the look for half a second, then pay it. A person, a wheel, a jar blocks the subject.
presets.focus: the hidden subject, already. The occluder can be soft.
presets.path: Short truck, 0.25 to 0.4m, just enough for the subject to clear the occluder. Stop as soon as the face or prop is readable. Do not keep traveling.
presets.parallax: Occluder and subject must be on different planes or the clear never happens.
do_not: Do not fully hide the subject at frame 0. The viewer should know something is there.
Do not use a foreground blur blob with no shape. The occluder is a real object in the set.
presets.video_model_line: 50mm, a real foreground object hides most of a face or prop, camera trucks just far enough to clear it over 1.4 seconds and then holds, focus already on the hidden subject, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Rival whip
presets.job: Jump from one side of an argument to the other inside the SAME set. This is a transition, not a scene.
presets.focus: match both sides. Do not rack during the whip.

start.note: last frame of the outgoing shot, already composed

end.note: first frame of the incoming shot, already composed

presets.path: Eight frames of directional motion blur along a pan of roughly 40 to 70 degrees. Do not try to render a readable character during these 8 frames. The shots on either side are ordinary quiet-push or parallax-slider shots with an 8-frame hold.
presets.easing: linear blur, not an ease. Eased whips look like a mistake.
presets.parallax: None. This is a smear. Parallax belongs to the shots it connects.
do_not: Do not whip to a different set. If the place changes, it is a cut, not a whip.
Do not whip more than once a film.
Do not put text on the whip frames.
presets.video_model_line: Eight frames of horizontal motion blur whipping from one framed person to another person in the same room, no readable face during the blur, no zoom, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Snap inset
presets.job: The one detail that makes the cause fair. A notch, a stamp, a gap, a reflection.
presets.focus: the detail, already sharp at frame 0
presets.path: Fast dolly in of 0.22m over 6 frames, 8% overshoot, settle by frame 12, then HOLD. No zoom. The hold is the shot. Cutting on the overshoot feels cheap.
presets.parallax: Tiny, because the move is short. The detail must be a real 3D edge, not a drawn circle that scales.
do_not: Do not punch in on a face for emphasis. This preset is for the mechanism.
Do not animate the detail itself more than the camera. The camera is the emphasis.
Do not use more than three snap-insets in one film.
presets.video_model_line: 85mm, a small mechanical detail is already sharp, camera dollies in fast over 6 frames with a slight overshoot, settles, and holds dead still, no zoom, no shake, vertical 9:16.

presets.name: Answer drift
presets.job: Last shot. The viewer restates the cause. Almost still.
presets.focus: the prop AND the result in the same deep-enough frame
presets.path: Dolly in 8 centimeters over the whole shot. That is all. If you can see the move without looking for it, it is too big.
presets.parallax: Barely. Enough that the frame is not a freeze, not enough to distract.
do_not: Do not end on a snap, a whip, or a black card.
Do not cover the prop with the last caption.
Do not introduce a new fact in this shot.
presets.video_model_line: 35mm almost-locked shot, camera creeps forward only 8 centimeters over 2.5 seconds, the prop and its result both visible, no pan, no zoom, no music sting camera move, vertical 9:16.
